expr: The lamp is a single, clear glass fixture, shaped like a rounded, somewhat flattened dome or bell. Inside the glass enclosure, a vertical, glowing filament, which appears bright yellow-orange, is visible.

This ice cream bar, depicted as a graphic on the kiosk, is predominantly light beige or off-white, with a dark brown, possibly chocolate, on its upper end. It has a smooth, rectangular shape with slightly rounded corners, set on a light brown stick protruding from its base. The overall appearance is clean and appetizing, despite being a printed image.

This is a dark-colored statuette, likely made of resin, depicting a human-like figure with sculpted purple hair and a voluminous, textured dark brown cloak that cascades around it. The cloak exhibits clear folds. The purple hair appears distinct and flowing.

This is a large, white A-frame or gabled canopy, forming the roof of a structure. It has two prominent sloped sections meeting at a central ridge, with the front-facing slope being most visible. The material appears sturdy and smooth, possibly corrugated metal or a similar solid sheet, reflecting some light, giving it a bright white appearance. Its texture is even and uniform.

This is a white cube, likely a Mahjong tile, with a smooth, reflective surface. On its top face, there are two blurry, dark vertical markings, which appear to be thin lines or abstract shapes, rendered out of focus. The material seems to be a hard, glossy substance like plastic or ceramic.

The object is a weathered stone, primarily dark brown in color with lighter, almost white, striations or mineral deposits running across its upper surface. It has an irregular shape, appearing wider at the base and tapering upwards to an uneven top. Its texture is rough and natural, typical of an outdoor rock, with visible worn areas.
The object is a person, partially visible. They are wearing a bright, vibrant pink long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans. The clothing appears to be made of fabric.

The object is a silver sedan. It has a smooth, somewhat reflective metal body, and visible rear taillights, a silver door handle and a rear window. The car appears to be a compact or mid-size model and shows some signs of use.
This is a rectangular horizontal sign with a bright blue background and white street name. The sign appears to be typical for street signage.

The object is a mushroom cap, broadly rounded with a somewhat flattened top. Its color is a dull reddish-brown, with a matte finish and speckled with darker brown points and dust or debris. There is a noticeable tear or indent on the left side of the cap. Its texture appears dry.

The fruit is yellowish-green with hints of pale orange, enclosed in clear, crinkled plastic wrap that reflects light. It has a round to slightly oval shape, resembling a small pomelo or grapefruit, and appears to have a skin texture beneath the wrapping. A small reddish-brown spot is visible at its top.

The pedestrian is a person wearing a grey jacket, black pants, and white athletic shoes with blue details. They also appear to be carrying a dark bag. The person has short, dark hair and seems to be in motion, walking forward.

The gravestone is a dark gray, rectangular, flat stone slab with a slightly angled top surface. It appears to be made of polished granite or a similar dark stone. On its top surface, there is an engraved Star of David on the left and what seems to be a insignia on the right, both in a metallic gold or brass color. Text is inscribed below these symbols.

This object is a low-lying, rectangular gravestone, predominantly reddish-brown in color, suggesting it is made of natural stone like granite or sandstone. Its surface appears rough and unpolished, with some areas possibly discolored or weathered. A thin layer of white snow rests on its top surface. There is no visible name on it.

The object is a translucent green bottle with a matching solid green plastic screw-on cap. It has a classic beverage bottle shape, with a relatively narrow neck flaring out to a wider body. A white price sticker is visible on the upper part of the bottle's body, and a white and green label with a visible barcode is present on its lower body.

The object is a medium-sized, light blue-grey metallic sedan car. It has a relatively flat roofline and rectangular headlights. The body appears smooth and somewhat reflective, consistent with a painted metallic surface. A black horizontal trim runs along the side of the body. The windows are clear glass.

This is an adult-sized bicycle with a dark frame. Its wheels feature brown rubber tires and metallic silver rims with spokes. The handlebars are silver with grips of other color. The design suggests a classic, upright city bike, appearing sturdy and well-maintained.

This large, structural pillar is light beige or off-white in color, with a possibly concrete texture. It tapers significantly from a wider base to a narrower shaft. A bright red sign is affixed to the lower part of the pillar.

This sculpture is a golden, rearing horse, depicted standing powerfully on its hind legs with its front legs bent and lifted. Its head is turned to the right, showcasing its muscular, athletic form. The surface appears smooth and metallic, suggesting a bronze or similar golden-colored metal material.

The object is a sculpted head, likely made of light gray, granular stone or concrete, exhibiting a rough, porous texture. It depicts the profile of a bald male head with a distinctive mustache and small beard. The shape is that of a relief or bust, with carved details for the facial features, ear, and hair.
The object is a black, brimmed hat, with a rounded crown and a flat brim. A dark brown band encircles the base of the crown. It appears to be made of a felt-like material.

The object is a large white bus, viewed from the rear. It has a generally rectangular shape with rounded corners, characteristic of public transport vehicles. The rear window is large and tinted black, with some snow accumulated on it. A small, rectangular license plate with black lettering is visible. The lower part of the bus features a yellow and red striped pattern.

The sculpture is dark grey to black, appearing to be made of stone, possibly basalt or granite. Its arms are crossed over its chest. The surface appears smooth, yet slightly textured, consistent with carved stone.

The player is wearing an orange football jersey with black accents on the shoulders and sides. A white sponsor logo is visible on the chest. He is also wearing black shorts and orange socks, complemented by light-colored football boots with some pink. His hair appears short and dark-colored. The player is captured in a dynamic pose.

This sculpture depicts a standing male figure, likely a saint or deity, rendered in a shiny silver-colored metallic material. The figure is bearded, with flowing robes that create voluminous drapery, and has both arms outstretched in a welcoming or blessing gesture. The metallic surface is reflective, hinting at a polished finish, and the details of the figures and drapery are intricately carved.
The object is a bicycle. The bicycle has a yellow frame with black tires. A black wire basket attached to the front handlebars.

The object is a woman with long, dark, wavy hair. She is wearing a bright, form-fitting, sleeveless orange one-piece suit that is short, exposing her legs. She is wearing black high-heeled shoes. Her posture suggests she is in motion.
The object is a rifle, primarily metallic grey and black in color. The gun barrel is cylindrical with a perforated muzzle brake featuring multiple circular holes. It rests on a black, V-shaped stand.

This hut features a prominent conical roof made of light brown or tan thatch, giving it a shaggy, fibrous texture. Its cylindrical walls below the roof are constructed from a woven material. The hut appears to be of moderate size.

The object is a barbell, characterized by its wavy, serpentine shape in the center and straight ends. It is metallic silver-grey in color, appearing to be made of steel, with black circular weight plates loaded on each end. The bar itself has knurling for grip and threaded ends for securing the weights. The weight plates are smooth and matte black.

This house is a multi-story building. Its most striking feature is a large, steeply pitched, multi-faceted roof covered in dark brown tiles, adorned with several prominent dormer windows. On the roof, there are also several satellite dishes and what appears to be an antenna. The roof tiles are distinct and show a layered texture. The building has a solid, sturdy appearance.

This object is a tall, cylindrical basket woven from natural brown fibers, likely bamboo or rattan, exhibiting a distinct vertical ribbed pattern from its construction. Its texture appears coarse and organic due to the woven material. The basket is partially filled with a yellowish substance.

The object is a large, dark green industrial waste bin, appearing to be made of sturdy plastic with a rectangular body. Its surface is dirty and shows signs of wear, consistent with outdoor use. The bin is significantly large and overflowing with various types of refuse, including cardboard boxes, plastic bags, and a coconut.

The object is a small, deciduous tree with a slender, dark greyish-brown trunk and a dense, rounded crown of yellowish-green leaves, indicative of autumn foliage. Its overall shape resembles a lollipop, with a distinct separation between the clearly visible trunk and the compact canopy. The texture of the leaves appears somewhat clustered.

The object is a clear plastic bottle, lying on its side, containing a little brown liquid. It has a red label with text. The bottle has a cylindrical body that narrows slightly towards the neck. It appears to be of a medium size, typical for a single-serving beverage.

The car is a classic, boxy sedan finished in a distinctive yellow-and-black paint scheme. It features rectangular headlights and a horizontal grille. The smooth roof is completely bare without any light or sign. The vehicle is a standard-sized compact sedan from its era, constructed of metal with glass windows.

The object is a large, rectangular double door, primarily painted a bright, light blue. It is composed of vertical wooden planks with horizontal crossbars, giving it a paneled appearance. There is a small, dark handle located on the left panel. The bottom edge of the door shows some dark wear and grime. The material appears to be painted wood with a matte finish.

The hand has a fair skin tone, with visible creases on the back. It is an open hand with fingers slightly splayed, resting casually. The fingernails are short and well-maintained. The texture appears normal for skin.
The tower is a tall, slender structure. It has a smooth, likely metallic exterior, and extends high into the sky. At its very top, there is a lighter colored section adorned with several small flags.

The uniform is light olive-grey in color, featuring prominent red shoulder epaulets and a white cross-body sash. Several medals or decorations with metallic glints are affixed to the chest area. The wearer also sports a bright white, flat-topped hat. The trousers are a matching light olive-grey, and the uniform is completed with dark, seemingly polished boots. The fabric appears smooth, indicative of a formal military garment, and the overall shape is that of a standing person, neatly tailored.

The door is a tall, narrow rectangular panel, predominantly light beige or off-white. The upper portion features a rectangular pane of frosted or translucent glass, where a red and blue logo is visible. It has a silver-colored metallic door handle.
The object is hair. The hair is on the head of a person whose dark clothing is visible directly below it. A small blue and yellow hair accessory is clipped into the hair near the top.

This is a rectangular medical monitor screen, predominantly dark with bright white, green, blue, and yellow graphics displaying waveforms and numerical data. The bezel surrounding the screen appears to be black or dark gray. The screen surface is smooth glass, and the casing is likely made of plastic or metal.

The object is a black or dark gray compact camera, likely a camcorder, with a prominent cylindrical lens on its front. A small red accent is visible near the lens. The lens itself has a silver or metallic ring. It appears to be made of plastic and possibly some metal.

The boat is a long, narrow wooden vessel with a dark brown hull. Its shape is typical of a traditional river boat. The wood appears to be aged and somewhat worn, suggesting extensive use. Inside, visible items include a bright yellow bucket, a white and blue striped cloth, and a small blue plastic basket.

The object is a man, dressed in a faded olive-green or khaki military uniform, consisting of a jacket, trousers, and a helmet. He wears dark, possibly black, high boots. His uniform appears slightly rumpled, suggesting fabric material. He has a dark object held to his ear, resembling a phone or communication device, and carries a pack or bag on his back.

The object is a large, weathered industrial crane, predominantly dark brown and rust-colored, indicating it's made of heavily oxidized metal. Its structure consists of a wide base, supporting a tall, angled boom that extends upwards and slightly to the left. The surfaces are rough and pitted with rust, giving it a very aged and robust appearance. On its side, several white English letters are visible on an attached black background. It features multiple smaller platforms and ladders integrated into its framework.
The object is a tall cylindrical pillar, primarily gray in color. It appears to be made of metal, likely steel or aluminum. A rectangular metal plate is attached to its surface, secured with screws.

This house features yellowish-orange stucco walls, a dark grey or brown tiled roof, and white-framed windows with dark green wooden shutters. It has a prominent gabled roof. The walls have no clearly visible plants on them, while the roof tiles show a slightly rougher, overlapping pattern. Sunlight illuminates the right side of the house, making the wall color appear vibrant.

The object is a tall, cylindrical pillar, primarily off-white or light grey in color. The surface appears signs of wear, including dark patches, and a small blue and white sticker adhered to its lower half. It is a substantial architectural element, likely made of painted concrete or stone.
The object is a house with a gabled roof, predominantly painted in a rich red color. It features a brown tiled roof. A black lamp is mounted on one of its walls.

This is a rectangular metal cart with a light blue top frame, designed to hold luggage. It has an open-cage structure with horizontal bars forming its sides and is supported by small wheels. The cart is overflowing with various pieces of luggage, including green and red suitcases, along with other bags, all piled high within its frame.

The object is a vibrant circle, serving as an opening on a waste receptacle. A few small water droplets are visible on it. It features a prominent black inner ring that defines the actual opening, which appears to lead into a dark void.
The object is a cube puzzle, commonly known as a Rubik's Cube variant. The center piece on one visible face has lost its surface. The cube appears to be made of smooth, glossy plastic.

The person is wearing a white t-shirt with red sleeves and a red collar. He has short, dark hair, standing upright and holding some strip-like objects in his hand. A yellow bib with Vietnamese text is visible on the front of his top.

The man is of average build and appears to be walking. He is wearing a black top and grey pants. One headphone hangs down from his neck. He is actively holding a large white protest sign with black handwritten text.
The object is a human hand with fair skin. The hand shows visible knuckles and slight creases on the skin, indicating a natural texture. A metallic ring is visible on one of the fingers.

This horse exhibits a distinct pinto coat pattern, primarily brown with patches of white. Its body appears muscular and well-proportioned. It is adorned with a pink decoration over its saddle, and bright green wraps on its lower legs, adding vibrant accents to its natural colors. The texture of its coat appears smooth.

This is a tall, slender skyscraper with a predominantly light grey and blue-tinted glass facade. Its shape is largely rectangular, but it features a distinctive crown-like top with multiple tiers and two prominent spires or antenna-like structures extending upwards.

The person is male, standing upright, and wearing a full camouflage uniform consisting of a long-sleeved top and pants, patterned with shades of orange, brown, green, and black. His hands are empty. He has dark-colored sturdy boots. His skin tone appears medium to dark, and his facial features are blurred.

This is a small, light green plastic stool with a top and four tapered legs that splay slightly outwards. The top surface has a subtle pattern. A small sticker is attached to it. Its size suggests it's a common, lightweight outdoor seating option.

This is a classic Volkswagen Beetle, dark gray in color with a smooth metallic finish. It has a distinctive rounded shape, prominent chrome bumpers, chrome hubcaps, and tires. On its roof, there is a dark-colored roof rack.

The balcony is predominantly light grey, with a textured, slightly rough stucco or concrete finish on its main platform. The railing is a lighter, almost white, matte metal bar. The balcony structure is rectangular and appears solid and substantial. It is cantilevered from the building. Small, grey pipes are visible protruding from its side, and a light fixture is also present on its underside closer to the center.
The object is a bicycle, positioned upright. It has a metal frame and black tires. Two red reflectors are visible on the bicycle.

The object is a life-sized statue of a soldier, holding what appears to be a black club or bat. It wears a dark green uniform and a dark green helmet adorned with a white circle containing the Roman numeral 'VII'. The material appears to be a rigid, smooth substance, likely painted concrete or fiberglass, with a matte finish.

The house is a single-story structure with white plastered walls and a prominent orange-red tiled gabled roof. The roof has a textured appearance from the tiles, and the white walls appear relatively smooth but show some signs of weathering and minor discoloration, particularly near the base. The foundation is a light grey or tan color, adding to the aged aesthetic. Several rectangular windows with white frames are spaced along the facade, and a small, dark brown awning provides cover over an entrance further to the right.

This is a tall, narrow, rectangular window with a white frame. The frame divides the window into multiple panes. The top section is divided, and the bottom left section appears to be a pane that is slightly ajar, tilting inwards. The glass panes reflect a distant scene including buildings with orange-brown bricks, white-framed windows, and bare tree branches, indicating it's a clear day. The window frame appears smooth and clean.

The jet is dark-colored, appearing black or very dark navy, with a sleek, aerodynamic design characteristic of a military training aircraft. The jet is positioned vertically. It is actively emitting a vibrant, opaque red smoke trail from its rear. The surface appears smooth and metallic.

This is a window with an arched top, featuring light green painted wooden frames and shutters. The glass reflects mostly the sky, with a small portion of dark foliage. Both shutters are open, revealing their slatted texture.

This rose is an artificial, fabric rosebud tilting to the left, displaying a gradient color transition from off-white at its base to light pink at its tips. It has a conical, elongated shape characteristic of an unopened bud, with slightly frayed edges on its petals and visible specks of dust, suggesting a soft, possibly aged, texture. One of its petals is hanging down to the left.

The window is rectangular with a light grey frame and mullions that divide it into four main panes, arranged in a two-over-two configuration. Behind the glass, light-colored, possibly white or off-white, horizontal blinds are visible, partially drawn.

This weapon is a long, slender pole-arm, possibly a naginata or a similar spear-like implement, featuring a prominent straight blade. The main shaft is a vibrant red, appearing smooth and possibly made of wood or metal, while the blade is a silver-grey metal. The weapon is oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, and the blade itself is sharp and pointed, suggesting a metallic texture.

The sculpture is made of clear ice, giving it a translucent appearance. It forms a stylized number eight or a similar flowing, abstract figure with smooth, curved surfaces. It is standing upright on an ice base.

The stone is light beige to off-white in color, with areas of grey and brown weathering, particularly at its base. It has an irregular, sculpted, and somewhat abstract S-curve or organic pillar shape. The material is a coarse, granular stone, possibly granite or sandstone, exhibiting a rough, weathered texture with visible grains and some minor surface imperfections. A distinct shadow falls across its right side.

The object is a person, likely an adult female, seen from behind. She is wearing a dark navy blue top, which appears to be made of an ordinary fabric. Her hair is dark and tied back. Her build appears to be slender to average.

The object is a bright yellow compact delivery van, typical of a commercial vehicle. It has a generally rectangular body with rounded edges, black rubber tires, and windows. The front lower bumper appears to be black plastic. On its side, the van displays a web address in black text and a distinctive blue and yellow logo. The surface is smooth and appears to be made of painted metal, with some minor reflections and shadows of tree leaves visible on its side.

The building is a tall, rectangular, light grey structure. On its visible side, there is a very large, colorful billboard displaying green, yellow, blue, and red graphics with text. Due to the viewing angle, only the front and the left side of the building are visible, while the right side cannot be seen. The building appears to be multi-storied.

The tower is a tall skyscraper with a distinctive shape. The building’s surface prominently reflects the vivid colors of the setting sun in a vertical band of bright orange and yellow down its center. It appears smooth, indicating a modern design.

This object is a horizontally oriented rectangular picture with an ornate golden or bronze frame. Inside the frame, set against a dark background, are a curved metallic dagger or sword and its scabbard. The frame itself appears to have intricate, possibly carved or molded detailing, giving it a textured look. The daggers have a polished metallic sheen.

This rectangular window features a dark brown frame, divided into one large lower pane and three smaller rectangular panes above, with the middle one half-open. The glass prominently reflects the intricate network of dark tree branches with leaves, suggesting a clear, reflective surface.
The car is a classic sedan with its windows open. Its overall shape reflects the typical design of cars from its era, giving it a distinctive and recognizable profile.

The object is a rectangular screen, oriented vertically, displaying a complex graphical interface with white, red, green, and blue elements against a dark background. The bezel surrounding the active display area is dark gray or black. The right side of the screen is partially obscured by a head.

This object is a half of a double door, primarily golden or brass in color, with clear glass panels. It is rectangular in shape and partially open, showing a glimpse of the interior. The frame has a smooth, reflective metallic texture.

This is a small, plush character head, predominantly light pink in color, resembling a cartoon rabbit. It is slightly tilted to the left. The two tall, upright ears have a lighter, slightly glittery pinkish-gold material on their inner surface. The face is embroidered with black details, giving it a playful expression. The object appears soft and fuzzy, consistent with a plush toy material.

This large elephant is dark grey, almost black, with visible wrinkles on its tough skin. It has a broad, robust body supported by four thick legs. A prominent trunk extends from its head, and small tusks are faintly visible. It is walking towards the right.

This is a large tower crane, primarily yellow or light orange in color, with a long horizontal jib extending to the left and a shorter end on the right. The crane's structure appears to be made of metal, exhibiting typical industrial textures with visible trusses and supports.

This pillar is a large, cream or light beige architectural element, likely made of stone or concrete, with a cylindrical fluted shaft, a decorative capital, and a substantial base. The base has a metal plaque attached, and part of the pillar is obscured by a streetlamp.
